mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pay_payment_order(order_no,payment_order_no,member_id,amount,status) VALUES(#{orderNo},#{paymentOrderNo},#{memberId},#{amount},'WAITING') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE order_no=order_no
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pay_payment_order WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE pay_payment_order SET status=#{status}, paid_payment_no=#{paidPaymentNo}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_no=#{orderNo}
